name: terbinafine + undecylenic acid
uses: Use Treats athlete's foot, ringworm, and jock itch. Helps improve the appearance of fungus-affected nails.
otcwarn: Do not use Do not use on children under 2 years unless directed by a doctor. Avoid contact with eyes. Rinse with water if contact occurs. Stop use and ask a doctor if irritation occurs.
